transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the state regulator's request regarding labeling for our recently distributed medical accessory. As we all know, the response is due within 30 days, and I have the authority to approve the filing and corrective-action plan. To date, we haven't filed a response, withdrawn the product, or notified customers. Before I can approve any external filing, our pre-filing routine requires regulatory counsel and product compliance to brief me on the substantive results of their checks. I'd like to get a status update from both teams on where those checks stand so we can move forward efficiently.
